reason: Verification failed on multiple critical specification mismatches (entities, parameters, metrics) and a key logic bug (adoption not tied to actual wearing). One iteration remains, and targeted changes can bring the implementation into alignment with the spec and likely pass verification. Prioritize minimal but complete compliance: fix adoption logic; add Household with basic sharing/norm reinforcement; implement PolicyAuthority with mandate scope and enforcement; integrate location-based observed norms; align parameters; and compute all required metrics and evaluation thresholds.

specific_areas: Tie mask_adoption_state to actual wearing via rolling adoption score; remove inventory/visit shortcut
Implement Household entity with member assignment, simple share_masks_among_members, and reinforce_household_norms
Replace HealthAuthority with PolicyAuthority including mandate_status, mandate_scope, enforcement_probability, fine_amount; apply scope per location
Compute and use observed location mask prevalence (norm_observation_in_locations) in decisions the next day
Use location_mix_distribution and contact_rate_by_location for visit sampling and contacts
Align parameters to spec and validate/clamp (probabilities in [0,1], non-negative inventories/prices)
Integrate basic purchase economics (budget, cost_sensitivity, purchase_threshold); track total_demand, total_supply, total_spent

Produce required metrics: time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, location_specific_adoption, adoption_disparity_index, enforcement_events, stockout_frequency, average_price_paid, mask_demand_supply_ratio, average_perceived_risk
Return pass/fail in evaluate(): adoption_curve_convergence (<0.005 over last 14 days), bounded_stockouts (<0.2), and mandate_effect_direction (>0)
Remove redundant pass statements and add light input validation

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-anchor on the Task Specification: required entities (Household, PolicyAuthority, MediaChannel), parameters (location_mix_distribution, contact_rate_by_location, mandate_scope, misinformation_rate), and exact metric names/definitions.

data_analysis.adjustments: Plan minimal data structures to capture per-day, per-location observed mask prevalence, demand vs supply, and price paid logs for metric computation.

model_planning.adjustments: Define a smallest-viable set of behaviors to satisfy spec: household sharing and norm reinforcement; mandate scope and enforcement per location; rolling adoption score; daily observed norms feedback loop.

code_generation.adjustments: Refactor with minimal invasive changes: add Household dataclass and PolicyAuthority; modify decision and purchasing functions; compute metrics; ensure parameter mapping to spec names; remove redundant pass statements.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks for presence of required classes and metrics keys; validate parameter ranges; run a short smoke test (e.g., 5 days) to ensure metrics arrays populate and evaluate() returns pass/fail flags.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Initialize prev_loc_mask_rate with neutral priors; ensure deterministic RNG across new components; keep main() invocation and CSV output stable.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Implement evaluation thresholds as boolean outcomes; verify mandate_effect_direction computed within scope and over pre/post windows; report both values and pass flags.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise change log noting alignment to spec, especially adoption logic fix, new entities, parameter mapping, and metric compliance.
